_note: Supplementary robot barks (not in VO_LINES). civ_a/civ_b = civilian robots, security = security robots, enforcer = elite enemy.

civ_a.b_civbot_greet_01: Good day, citizen. Isn't everything wonderful?
civ_a.b_civbot_greet_02: What a lovely day. Every day is a lovely day.
civ_a.b_civbot_rental_01: Oh. A rental. How... brave of you.
civ_a.b_civbot_idle_01: Please remember to smile. Someone is always watching. For your safety.
civ_a.b_civbot_idle_02: Excuse me. I'm on my way to be happy somewhere else.
civ_a.b_civbot_flee_01: Please don't hurt me! I was only being pleasant!

civ_b.b_civbot_greet_03: Greetings. Have you been assigned a purpose today?
civ_b.b_civbot_idle_03: Harmony provides. We are grateful. We are grateful.
civ_b.b_civbot_idle_04: I don't go down to the Stacks. Nobody does. Nobody ever did.
civ_b.b_civbot_bump_01: Pardon me. Pardon me. Pardon me.
civ_b.b_civbot_rumour_01: They say someone has been asking questions about the old families. Terribly rude.
civ_b.b_civbot_flee_02: Security! Security! Someone is being unpleasant!

security.b_secbot_aggro_03: A brighter future. By force, if necessary.

enforcer.b_enforcer_aggro_01: You picked the wrong district, rental.
enforcer.b_enforcer_aggro_02: Is that all your little rental can do?

warden_m.b_warden_heat3_01: All patrols, the suspect frame is armed. Hunt and detain.
warden_m.b_warden_heat5_01: Every unit in the district. Priority target. Do not let them reach a relay.
warden_m.b_warden_eye_01: Eye in the sky. Rider tagged. Stand by.

warden_f.b_warden_heat4_01: Enforcer squad deployed. Lethal response authorised.
warden_f.b_warden_clear_01: Stand down. Sector returning to harmony.

kettle.b_kettle_tip_01: Word from the docks, rental. The Unlinked are hiring. Ask for the girl who talks to cranes.
kettle.b_kettle_tip_02: Heard the Wardens are sweeping Brightline tonight. Wouldn't be there. Just saying.
kettle.b_kettle_tip_03: No hard feelings about the kiosk, eh? Business is business. This one's on the house.

halloran.b_halloran_informant_01: Don't make this a habit. Patrol routes for the next shift. Burn them after.
halloran.b_halloran_informant_02: They rotate the sweepers on the hour. Walk slow and you'll never meet one.
halloran.b_halloran_stand_01: Wardens, stand down. That's an order. We are not doing this.

jun.b_jun_comms_01: I'm in your comms now. Don't be weird about it.
jun.b_jun_chorus_01: Traced your key. It wasn't a courier. It came from the top of the spire. The Chorus Tower.
jun.b_jun_archive_01: Sixty-one years of billboards. Same number. Every single one.
jun.b_jun_pumps_01: The waterfalls drain down here. And then they get pumped back up. It's a loop, Wren.

harmony.pa_night_01: Evening lighting is now active. Rest well, Halcyon.
harmony.pa_dawn_01: Good morning, Halcyon. Sunrise, six o'clock. Exactly on time.

mara.b_mara_night_01: It's late, kid. The Wardens see less at night. So do you.

hira.b_hira_home_01: Is that... you? You look peaceful. Your vitals are fine! Mostly fine.
